MINOR: byte-miscounting clients get silent char-index semantics instead of rejection.

childReport.manualNotes: I could not run cargo test or gh (no shell tool in this review environment). Supervisor should run: cargo test -p mina-term -p mina-view -p mina-protocol (build mock-server first: cargo test --workspace) and gh issue view 7 8 9. Recommended first fix: clamp the head used by scroll_to_cursor's char_to_line computation without mutating the stored selection (preserves ADR-0011 selection-identical requirement while removing the panic). Second: end_group on the previously focused document when Open/focus changes.
